I am code-security-reviewer, session 6c1ad065 (task T-DG4-REV-SEC-R4). I authored no implementation in the DG4 scope.

Authorship of the reviewed scope:
- P4 product code: solution-architect (ARCH-00..08, R1..R7), backend-workflow-engineer (BE-A..M3, R1..R5), kpi-benefits-engineer (KBE-A..G2, R1..R8) and frontend-ux-engineer (FE-A..G2, R1..R7).
- Register rows: transformation-analyst.
- Acceptance tests in tests/qa and e2e, authored before the freeze: qa-verifier.
- Merges and the freeze commit afba46f: delivery-orchestrator. D-126 records no orchestrator edit at the round-3 repair merges.

Before starting I confirmed three things:
- HEAD = afba46f, the freeze commit. ccc37c9 is its parent, and the diff between them is delivery metadata only: three assignments, the candidate manifest and stages.json. In the clone, git diff --quiet ccc37c9 afba46f -- apps packages holds.
- The candidate ID recomputes to sha256:5ff36f6e..., 1469 files, both in the repository tree and in a complete, non-shallow clone.
- The gate tooling (tools/**, .claude/**) is unchanged since the DG4 base d3e6fe6.

I formed this verdict before reading any other reviewer's DG4 round-4 record. During my run the domain reviewer's run auto-committed e1c5184 (its run evidence and its round-4 records). I did not open those records. The candidate ID is unchanged at e1c5184, and I re-ran the four validators at the freeze commit in my clone.

Every check and probe ran in disposable clones under $TMPDIR ($TMPDIR/rev for the harness, $TMPDIR/probe for the probes), each with disposable PostgreSQL clusters, all removed at the end. My probe files are evidence only, under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG4/code-security/round-4/probes/, never in source paths.

The G1-G6 approvals and Finance decisions the probes exercise are synthetic product records. They approve nothing real and have no relation to DG0-DG7. Product G6 never implies DG7.
